threads.text:
DC's cherry blossom festival turns 100: 2027 dates are out

When: Mar 20 to Apr 11, 2027. Kite festival Mar 27, parade Apr 10.

Cost: Kite festival and sidewalk parade free. Grandstand seats $28 to $45, some listings still 2026.

Peak bloom averages Apr 3, but can't be called far ahead. We'd pick a refundable hotel.

Checked on nationalcherryblossomfestival.org on November 4.
